checks.name: Plan and frozen label policy
checks.evidence: probe_geometry_commit.py:95-139 intervenes once at the query and advances RecoverabilityTracker for each arrived future image. train_geometry_commit.py:69-70 uses offsets 1..H, excluding query IoU from the future utility. Saved gpu1 fit metadata has H=3 and selected epoch 41 with the specified old4 parent. The new control changes continuation scheduling only.

checks.name: Event trigger, dispatch and exact horizon
checks.evidence: geometry_commit_event.py:17-25 compares the chosen commit action against the original old4 int(pause). A differing action at q sets q+H. RecoverabilityTracker.step increments the frame before accept_observation; the <= guard therefore directly calls RecoverabilityTracker.accept_observation on q+1 through q+H and returns to GeometryCommitTracker on q+H+1. The first-frame two-history guard leaves commit_action None at the event check and does not create a spurious event. Both geometry changes and legal appearance-only action differences trigger the window.

checks.name: Normal old4 evolution inside the window
checks.evidence: Only accept_observation dispatch changes during continuation. RecoverabilityTracker.step still searches the current arrived image, selects candidates and a pause action, and runs the ordinary _advance, template write rules, identity and motion memory updates, and history append. No image is skipped, past output rewritten, search box frozen or state restored. Existing GeometryCommitTracker action and geometry definitions remain unchanged.

checks.name: Private teacher state and non-circular sanity
checks.evidence: check_geometry_event_sanity.py:74-76 copies state and constructs an actual RecoverabilityTracker object, so teacher.step dispatches the base old4 methods rather than the event subclass. private_state separately copies the branch, boxes, deque containers, stats, history arrays, identity/motion tensors and template_source_box. Shared frozen networks and anchor/template tensors are read-only in the inspected path; _advance allocates new template tensors and both memory update functions return new tensors. Each teacher frame independently reruns inference on the same newly arrived image and comparisons cover output, search box, template, identity memory, motion memory and history. No expected state is copied from the event tracker after stepping.

checks.name: Sanity scope and non-vacuous completion
checks.evidence: Frame 0 initializes and range(1,120) tracks the next 119 actual images. Only readline supplies the initialization annotation. The sanity requires at least one completed event window and equality between matched teacher frames and the continuation counter, so zero triggered events cannot PASS. H3 timing is also checked independently from the real source guard/deadline scalar expressions in this review. This source review does not claim the real 120-frame test has run.

checks.name: Default evaluator behavior and additive telemetry
checks.evidence: The optional CLI defaults to frame. Existing invocations still dispatch RecoverabilityTracker or GeometryCommitTracker exactly as before; teacher_horizon requires a commit model and takes H from its saved training args. An actual arguments() AST comparison against HEAD preserved every prior CLI default. old4_continuation and old4_until_frame are post-step diagnostics; continuation-frame and event counters are serialized only for the new mode. GeometryCommitTracker resets commit_action each step and records the base pause action on skipped-head frames.

checks.name: Prior native consumers and fixed checkpoint gate
checks.evidence: geometry_event_pipeline.gate checks this review PASS and the selected gpu1/e41 head, then requires each of the four original native shell PIDs absent or zombie and both dataset success markers per GPU. run_geometry_native.sh emits each marker only after its synchronous evaluator returns successfully, and its tracked shell encloses both datasets. Every explicit new stage calls the gate. This is a source check of the barrier, not a new observation that current consumers are closed.

checks.name: Sanity-first complete98 partitions and explicit launching
checks.evidence: The runner starts only the explicitly requested stage. prepare requires a completed non-vacuous sanity and the saved complete98/49418 frame-policy record. It partitions the same sorted validation names using existing prediction lengths, without reading GT. launch uses max-frames=0, the fixed parent/head, teacher_horizon, action write verification and seed42, and assigns contiguous nonoverlapping offsets/counts to four GPUs. No training or native-test model selection is introduced.

checks.name: Merge, actual-GT scoring and paired comparison
checks.evidence: merge_score requires each new worker terminal, matching per-shard source counts, sequence order and model/continuation config, exact prediction/latency shapes and finite values, and a matching continuation timeline count. The union must be 98 unique videos/49418 frames before hard-linking. The merged smoke/config schema and --predictions/--model arguments match score_full98_cpu.py. That scorer reads real TRAIN annotations and uses the same existing localization_quality for both policies. The comparison aligns per-sequence IoU by name and computes 5000 seed42 paired sequence bootstrap draws in percentage points; it does not call this LasHeR SR or native accuracy.
